summary:
Reviewed ff22a77 (the only commit between ready->claimed b4a211e and claimed->done; branch gone), matching the implementer's result.
No change under features/, no test removed or weakened, allowances none. tools check: style-only ruff, vulture clean; size: nothing over 300.
F1 Important, fix now: migrate upgrade fails (FileNotFoundError, exit 1) on a repository with .shop/ but no .shop/work/, the repository r19's own scenario builds. The version is never recorded, so the hook offers the upgrade forever.
F2 Important, observation: a block-list blocked_by/depends_on is not renamed (r26).
F3 and F4 Minor, observations: tracebacks on a bad plugin-version or log line; cross-initiative blocked_by left dangling.
questions: Important, scripts/migrate_upgrade_ids.py:33: initiatives() calls iterdir on a missing .shop/work, so `migrate upgrade` refuses (exit 1) on a repository with .shop/ and no .shop/work/ and never records the version (r20, r25); fix: return [] when the directory is absent.
